sourceRequirements.summary:
PLOS ONE places no limit on length, figures, or supporting information — acceptance turns on methodological rigour rather than novelty — but the abstract is capped and unstructured.

Distilled requirements: No body word limit; abstract up to 300 words; required sections: Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion; Vancouver citation style.

Also required: Data availability statement required; Ethics approval statement required for human/animal studies; ORCID iD recommended for all authors; Figures must be high-resolution (≥300 DPI) separate files.

This summary is the app's distillation — open the author instructions above to confirm against the journal's current text.
